facts.fact: 6月28日 David 在自己的 GlobalVill 频道收到用户 “Jim”（用户名自带引号）的私信——该账号三天前才注册——自称追查 Public Access Afterworld 广播已 many years、称这是他不知道的 uncataloged transmission；当时 David 的帖子已被锁两周，上传视频总共只有 lackluster 的 thirty-eight views。
facts.anchor: On June 28, David received a private message on his GlobalVill channel from a user named “Jim” (quotation marks included in the username). “Jim’s” account had been created three days prior.

facts.fact: David 最终断定 “Jim” 是 Ralph 用三天前注册的 burner account 从镇子另一头 troll 他（该账号页无个人信息、无上传视频），于是没有打扰 Erin 的旅行，怕又一次假警报会终结调查和两人的友谊。
facts.anchor: Ralph knew all about David’s message board post. He knew how desperate David was for his investigation to bear fruit. And so he’d made a burner account (with quotation marks around the fake name, just to rub it in) to troll David from across town.

facts.fact: David 回帖警告 “This is not a creepypasta or an MMORPG…Otherwise, fuck off”，“Jim” 却在几分钟内回复，称必须尽快当面谈，问他们两人能否开车去他在 Troy, New York 州外的家。
facts.anchor: It is very important that we speak asap, in person. I live outside Troy, New York. Are you and your friend able to drive to my home?

facts.fact: “Jim” 自报姓名 Jim Davis、住 3462 Oakwood Drive，并上传其频道第一条视频 “Public Access Afterworld sample broadcast”——七秒长、数码相机拍摄、内容是空荡荡高中体育馆里一颗篮球；David 仍认定是 Ralph 搞鬼，回帖 “Fuck you Ralph.”
facts.anchor: It was called “Public Access Afterworld sample broadcast.” It was seven seconds long, shot on digital camera inside what appeared to be an empty high school gymnasium.

facts.fact: Google 证实 Troy, New York 郊外的 3462 Oakwood Drive 确有 Jim Davis 其人：他是 Schenectady 一所特殊需要学生私立高中的 guidance counselor，并非创作 Garfield 的那位 Jim Davis。
facts.anchor: No, Jim Davis of Troy, New York, was just some dude: a guidance counselor currently employed at a private high school for students with special needs in Schenectady, New York.

facts.fact: Erin 回来两天后 David 把全部往来给她看；Erin 看完体育馆视频坐了整整三十秒说 “It’s real”，随后把视频连看重放了四遍，而 David 仍觉得那是廉价伪造。
facts.anchor: Erin reloaded the video and watched it again, her eyes closer to the computer screen this time. Once it was over, she clicked the little arrow icon and watched it for a third time. And then a fourth.

facts.fact: Erin 看似毫无迟疑想接受去 Jim 家的邀请，David 劝阻：若不是 Ralph 而真是陌生 guidance counselor 约他们去林中家里，那就是 “textbook pedophile shit”；Erin 回答 “I trust him”。
facts.anchor: “We don’t know this guy. If it isn’t Ralph, and it’s actually some random guidance counselor inviting us to his house in the woods, that’s some textbook pedophile shit. Think about it.”

facts.fact: 在 Erin 催促下 David 先发消息道歉（“i thought you were my friend messing with me”）；两人折中——David 选了高速旁一家 Yelp 评论超过一百条的 diner（他觉得在那里被 murder 或 abducted 不易无人察觉），并给那个他仍不信叫 Jim Davis 的 GlobalVill 账号发消息，定下见面日期。
facts.anchor: They compromised. David picked a public place, a diner off the highway with more than a hundred Yelp reviews where he reasoned it’d be hard for them to be murdered or abducted without anyone noticing.
